evaluation_limitations.false_positive_rate: not reported: PPPwn entry is outside the frozen root set and FW 13.52 is not a clean negative corpus
evaluation_limitations.positive_recall: one held-back positive was missed; report 0 of 1 as an outcome, not a stable rate
evaluation_limitations.ranking_depth: the frozen -0.5 x entry-depth term was not machine-exported in chainmap; full tie ordering is not reproducible. All observed top-10 entries are direct proved handlers, so the held-back root-cause miss is unchanged.

metrics.entry_coverage: whether the generic root set reaches the family entry class
metrics.false_positive: claims on PPPwn NEGATIVE / analysed functions, with numerator, denominator and 95% upper bound
metrics.ranking_hit: matching root-cause chain in frozen top-10
metrics.root_cause_recall: proved rank<=2 chain whose evidence matches the labelled root-cause class; subsystem hit alone is zero

note: Release source after post-evaluation requirement-status repair. The independent evaluation remains the cycle-4 frozen run; release chainmaps differ only in requirements, not graph, hops, statuses, counts or ranking inputs.

post_evaluation_repair.change: infer syscall/cdevsw entry_kind only for all-proved chains so REQ_UNPRIV_ENTRY is cleared exactly when offline entry evidence proves it
post_evaluation_repair.verification: cycle-4 and release exports are byte-equivalent after removing the requirements field; 122/750 FW 13.52 chains now clear the entry requirement

score_terms: + 2 if the primitive carries a decisive identity domain (handle)
+ 1 if a surplus reference is proven
+ 1 if a cross-subsystem hop is witnessed
- 2 if the chain depends on a 'possible' or 'unknown' hop

repair_from_cycle2.cause: split-record continuation crossed another known syscall handler root; the finding label was expansion-order attribution, not ownership
repair_from_cycle2.generic_rule: known entry handlers are continuation barriers; explicit call/jump/table edges may still cross them
repair_from_cycle2.training_control: 9.00 netcontrol must resolve only through sysent[99]; 13.52 likewise

selection: all integrated families not marked training and not previously evaluated; no family was discarded after selection
